name: Global Distance Query via Local-Global Blending
definition: A method to extend local patch-based surface representation to a feature-preserving global signed distance field $F_G$ by blending the local representation $F_L$ with an ordinary global signed distance field $F_O$.
summary: Global Distance Query via Local-Global Blending combines a local patch-based SDF with a global learned field to preserve sharp geometric details while enabling valid distance queries across the entire domain.
